prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: full-fidelity desktop production app screenshot, exactly 1280x800 first viewport
Primary request: Create one polished Wicker Study screen for the route /app/updates, titled ‘Updates’, using the supplied image only as the exact visual design and workspace-shell reference. Preserve the established Wicker Study design language and left sidebar faithfully while replacing the main Courses content with a Course Signal Board.
Input image: .impeccable/review/desktop.png is a style, composition, spacing, typography, and sidebar reference; it is not the edit target.
Composition: Preserve the existing left workspace sidebar. Make Updates active. Add the Updates header, Canvas refresh metadata, Refresh outline action, local tabs, a broad ruled course register for BCS1540 Algorithmic Design, BCS1520 Statistics, and BCS3120 Ubiquitous Computing, plus a compact right rail for selected-course activity and Canvas connection health. Status is communicated through marks, weight, and position rather than colorful pills. Canvas red appears only in its source logomark.
Style: warm #f7f7f4 canvas, white flat ruled planes, near-black #20263a, indigo #3f51d9, Archivo / Archivo Narrow character, 32px / 18px / 16px heading ladder, 14px major corners, edge-to-edge internal rules, crisp production app screenshot.
Constraints: exact 1280x800 PNG; no gradients, glass, nested cards, marketing copy, em dashes, extra colors, browser chrome, device frame, perspective, or watermark.
